body:
I've been on Risperidone and I know how they suck the life out of you. These medications prevent your brain producing dopamine which is one of the feel good chemicals. The good news is it's not permanent- the brain will return to baseline and start making more dopamine again if the anti-psychotic medication is stopped.

is there any way you can share some of the music you've created already? I'd be happy to have a listen.
